title: Periosteum

inlines.v: PERIOS'TEUM, noun [Gr. about, and bone.] A nervous vascular membrane endued with quick sensibility, immediately investing the bones of animals. The periosteum has very little sensibility in a sound state, but in some cases of disease it appears to be very sensible.
